# New Standout Games to Check Out on Roblox This Month


Incubator and Jumpstart Applications Now Open for New Creators


By


Jim Greer, Senior Director of Engineering


Published


Nov 16, 2026


Part of my job is watching what creators do when we hand them new tools, and lately it’s been a lot of fun. Over the past month, a wave of new games has taken off on Roblox by trying things that haven’t been done on the platform before, from physics-driven cat brawls to a turn-based open-world RPG. Many of them come from teams in our[Incubator and Jumpstart programs](http://create.roblox.com/build) , where we work side-by-side with creators on the next generation of breakout hits. Here are a few I think you should play this week.


###### **Recent Releases**


[Adventure Time RPG](https://www.roblox.com/games/118915268278945/Adventure-Time-RPG)


***Creator:*** *Oh My Glob Games*


***Genre:*** *Role-playing game (RPG)*


***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*


***Maturity:*** *Mild*


The world of “Adventure Time” has officially landed on Roblox!


Welcome to the Land of Ooo, lovingly re-created from the hit Cartoon Network series, where Finn, Jake, and their friends are headed for adventure. Players smack down mobs and mega bosses, battle through the Dungeon Train, and take on quests that are epic, goofy, mathematical, or all three. Between fights, there are opportunities to fish for rewards and plenty of chilling in the Tree House.


Easy to learn, hard to put down, this official “Adventure Time” world provides a ton of sword-clanging fun.


[Cat Battles](https://www.roblox.com/games/130906410042392/Cat-Battles)


***Creator:*** *Cute Malt Games*


***Genre:*** *Action/Battlegrounds*


***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*


***Maturity:*** *Minimal*


Got nine lives? You’ll need them.


The arena is open, and the cats are ready to brawl. They punch, grab, and hurl each other across dynamic maps and ever-changing battlegrounds. Every hit lands with real weight, and every flop is hilarious. Thanks to their implementation of[Server Authority](https://about.roblox.com/newsroom/2026/07/creating-responsive-cheat-resistant-games-roblox-server-authority) , the chaos stays smooth and competition gets *real* .


Start with the basics: punch, grab, throw. Before long, players will be chaining combos and pulling off moves that make their friends ask, “Wait, how did you do that?”


“We built Cat Battles in three days with the help of Roblox Assistant and released it early on purpose,” said the game’s developer, Malt. “We wanted real players telling us what’s fun, not guesses. Every week, the community helps shape what comes next.”


“We wanted every hit to land with real weight,” Malt continued. “So the game is entirely based in physics. The Roblox engine determines how different fighting moves will combine. I’m finding new capabilities every day by seeing players combine moves and share them.”


[Evermore High](https://www.roblox.com/games/138636753681976)


***Creator:*** *Paper Swan Games*


***Genre:*** *RPG/Dress Up*


***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*


***Maturity:*** *Minimal*


Evermore is where high school levels up: bigger style, bigger stories, and a whole social scene. Players can express their personal style, find a crew, attend classes, and find their place on campus.


Inspired by the magic of[Royale High](https://www.roblox.com/games/735030788/Royale-High) and the creative flair of[Dress to Impress](https://www.roblox.com/games/15101393044/Dress-To-Impress) , Evermore is a role-play world for players seeking drama, glam, and self-expression. Behind the game is a small, creative-first team of Roblox veterans with about 20 games under their belts. Together, they made the game they always wished existed.


“We kept looking for a game made for girls and young women that felt a little more grown-up, and we couldn’t find one,” said EloraEvermore, one of the creators behind Paper Swan Games. “So we built it. Evermore is the high school role-play we wanted to play ourselves.”


###### **Incubator Games Now in Alpha/Beta Testing**


The first cohort of[Roblox Incubator](https://create.roblox.com/docs/creator-programs/incubator) is well underway, and participating games are releasing their alphas and betas. From a turn-based sandbox RPG to a desert-drifting open-world racer, put your skills to the test and help inform the future of the games as they work toward their full releases.


Want to build what comes next? Applications are now open for the second cohort of the Roblox Incubator, made up of two three-month sprints for teams creating novel games that will appeal to 18+ players. If creators have an idea that pushes the boundaries of genre, gameplay, and visual style, they can[apply today](http://create.roblox.com/build) to work directly with Roblox experts who provide mentorship and support, and help new games find their audience.


[NEMESIS](https://www.roblox.com/games/18679703121/NEMESIS)


***Creator:*** *RoyalFire Legends*


***Genre:*** *Shooter*


***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*


***Maturity:*** *Mild*


NEMESIS is a high-speed FPS where movement is your greatest weapon. Players wall-run, vault, slide, and chain parkour moves to outmaneuver opponents in intense free-for-all death matches. Tactical abilities can turn the tide of a fight, and new weapons, wraps, abilities, and maps are on the way.


Be the first to experience the future of movement shooters in their alpha, live today.


[Octane](https://www.roblox.com/games/12650636785/Octane)


***Creator:*** *Ignition Switch*


***Genre:*** *Racing*


***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*


***Maturity:*** *Minimal*


Sprawling across the colorful streets of La Vista and the desert beyond, Octane is an open-world driving game built for exploring. Cars drift through town and tear across the dunes, with a whole vibrant landscape to discover between the starting line and the horizon.


Built-in races keep the adrenaline up, with an immersive physics system keeping every corner ahead satisfying and fresh. Solo or with friends, players can customize their cars, show off their collection, and explore the world of Octane.


[Divine](https://www.roblox.com/games/78957164244171/Divine)


***Creator:*** *Plaything by WhoseTrade*


***Genre:*** *RPG*


***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*


***Maturity:*** *Minimal*


Divine is an open-world sandbox RPG where every battle is turn-based, and every corner of the map invites exploration. Players craft, build up their strength, and decide how to approach a sprawling world at their own pace.


Built by the Roblox-native studio Plaything and award-winning Roblox creator WhoseTrade, the game is still in alpha, but it’s growing fast. Player feedback is shaping the game, and its developers are updating the game often.


“As a native developer, Incubator got us out of the rhythm we were in and pushed us to experiment with new technologies like Character Control Library (CCL), Animation Graphs, Input Action System, and Streaming that we honestly weren’t looking at,” said Jonathan “WhoseTrade” Courtney, Founder of Plaything. “Now that we’ve explored them, they’re already being utilized in other projects outside of Divine. We rapidly experimented and iterated on a ton of concepts, and many got scrapped, but those learnings are going to produce a web of projects. In a few months there will probably not be a single game out of our team where we cannot trace it back to something we trialed directly on Divine because of Incubator.”


###### **Games From the 100+ Jumpstart Teams**


Since we launched Jumpstart earlier this year, over 100 teams have joined the community-focused program and begun releasing their creations. Take a look at some of the games available to play below, and submit your next great game idea using the[Jumpstart application form](http://create.roblox.com/build) . No Roblox experience required.


[Swarm Rush](https://www.roblox.com/games/116444895459651/Swarm-Rush)


***Creator:*** *Kluge Games*


***Genre:*** *RPG/Action RPG*


***Platforms:*** *Mobile, PC*


***Maturity:*** *Moderate*


In this cybernetic Wild West game, the machine army never stops coming. Squads of up to four choose from four unique classes (Gunslinger, Preacher, Scorcher, and Longhorn) and fight off relentless swarms, sharing the XP every kill drops. When a teammate goes down, the squad picks them back up and keeps fighting.


Every run is different. Roguelite upgrade cards change each build, and the swarm only grows larger as a squad lasts longer. Out on the frontier, hidden activities pay out extra cash, gold, and XP for those bold enough to chase them. Survive long enough, take the fight to the final boss, and extract with everything earned.


Nothing earned goes to waste. Spend it between runs on permanent progression and come back stronger.


[Woodlands](http://roblox.com/games/107415888785617/Woodlands) ******


***Creator:*** *Whimco Studios*


***Genre:*** *Survival/Escape*


***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*


***Maturity:*** *Mild*


Countless Quirkymals have recently vanished in Woodlands. Squads of friends are tasked with venturing into the woods to find the lost Quirkymals, keep their hungry companions fed, and bring everyone safely back to camp. But the search party isn’t alone—monsters hunt explorers and the rescued alike. Stealth and strategy decide who makes it out.


The peaceful charm doesn’t last. Each trip slowly reveals a spooky world that is always watching, and every rescued Quirkymal joins a growing collection back home. Headphones recommended: Listening closely might be the difference between a rescue and a close call. How many can you save before the forest takes you?


***COMING SOON:***


[Monster in the Mansion](https://www.roblox.com/share/g/347718356)


***Creator:*** *Ubermonster Productions and Anthony Francisco*
***Genre:*** *Asymmetrical Survival Horror*
***Platforms:*** *Console, PC, Mobile*
***Maturity:*** *Mild*


This winter, players will have a choice: be the monster or run from it.


Behind the doors of Doctor Mondo’s mansion, monsters have been set loose and every hallway is a chase. Players either embody the monsters or evade them in an action-packed game of cat and mouse. Each round plays out differently, so no one ever knows who’s the hunter until it’s too late.


Richly detailed creatures and environments give every corner something to fear, and a deep world gives every escape a story worth sharing with friends.


There are a lot of new worlds to explore on Roblox this season. Pick a game, grab a friend, and see what happens. When you’re ready to build your own, Incubator and Jumpstart applications are open.
